title: Type mismatch in function signature
detail: The function signature uses `Iterable[optparse.Option]` instead of `Iterable[Any]`, which may cause type checking issues if `opts` contains elements not of type `optparse.Option`.

title: Type hint for command_class
detail: The type hint `type[Command]` assumes that `getattr(module, class_name)` will always return a subclass of `Command`, which may not be true if `class_name` is incorrect or the module does not contain the expected class.

title: Potential ImportError
detail: Using `importlib.import_module` without error handling may raise an `ImportError` if the module does not exist, which is not currently handled.
